messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: How to change encoding?
parts:
Hey Arturo what about this:


library(shiny)

string.to.hex <- function(string){
  paste0("\\x", paste(iconv(string, toRaw=TRUE)[[1]], collapse="\\x"))
}

title <- "Mi sesión"
html <- paste0('<script>document.write("', string.to.hex(title), '");</script>')


runApp(
  list(ui=pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel(HTML(html)),

sidebarPanel(),
    mainPanel(
      verbatimTextOutput("locale")
    )
  ),
  server=function(input, output) {
    output$locale <- renderPrint({ sessionInfo()$locale })
  })
)
